items.text:
4. ESTABLISH – 1-HOUR PARKING, 7 AM TO 6 PM, EVERYDAY EXCEPT SUNDAYS
Irving Street, north side, between 46th Avenue and 47th Avenue
(Supervisor District 4) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Jeffrey Tom, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposal to add a parking time limit to encourage parking turnover and address reports of driveway
blocking.


Public Comments: Received one email prior to public hearing asking for clarification on the
proposal’s benefits to residents. During the hearing, comments received regarding other previous
proposed changes on this block at prior hearings and No Right Turn restrictions on Lincoln leading to
additional traffic on 46th Ave. Question raised about the proposal’s benefits to residents.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.

Parnassus Avenue, south side, from 170 feet to 260 feet east of 3rd Avenue
(Supervisor District 5) (Approvable by the City Traffic Engineer) Larry Yee, [staff email removed — see the order]

Red zones are proposed on Parnassus Avenue due to sidewalk widenings proposed related to the
Parnassus Streetscape Improvement Project, Phase 1.1.

Public Comments: Comments received regarding street name in graphic and environmental review
timeline. Question raised about parking impact.

will now be permanent. #
